title: User Overview
subtitle: One page to support any member
summary: Support staff need to answer “what happened to this member?” quickly and fix it safely. I redesigned the member page in the admin: balances, manual adjustments with a reason, offer redemption and undo, and a filterable activity timeline, with guardrails for each admin role.

problem.statement: Answering a member's question meant piecing together balances, offers and history, and correcting a balance had to be done carefully so it could be traced and reversed.
problem.bizCtx: Brand admins and MyLoyal support use the member page to resolve questions about points, wallet and stamps across every brand on the platform.
problem.constraints: Three roles use the page, Super Admin, Admin and Test Mode, each with different permissions. Every change to a member's balance needs a record and a way back.

contribution.summary: I designed the member overview, the adjustment and redemption flows, and the activity timeline.
contributions: Designed the member overview: tier, balances for points, wallet and stamps, and available offers.
Designed manual adjustments for points, wallet and stamps, each with a reason, plus cancelling an adjustment.
Designed redeeming and undoing offers on a member's behalf, with confirmations that adapt to the admin's role.
Designed an activity timeline with a type filter, so every change to a member can be traced.

findings.evidence: Adjustments and redemptions are sometimes made by mistake.
findings.implication: Every adjustment and redemption has an undo path, recorded in the timeline.

findings.evidence: Super Admin, Admin and Test Mode have different permissions.
findings.implication: Confirmations and warnings adapt to the role.

findings.evidence: “Where did my points go?” is answered by what happened, in order.
findings.implication: A filterable activity timeline sits on the member page.

insight.decision: One member page where support can see, change and undo, with every action traced in a timeline.

design.solution: The member page leads with tier and balances, then available offers. Adjusting a balance opens a focused modal with the current balance, the amount, and a reason. The activity timeline lists every event and can be filtered by type.

image.label: Adjusting a points balance
image.alt: The adjust points balance modal over the member overview.

design.flows: Find a member, check balances and history, then adjust a balance, redeem an offer, or undo a previous action. Each action shows up in the timeline straight away.
design.annotations: Destructive or unusual actions, like cancelling a manual adjustment, get an explicit confirmation that explains the effect before anything changes.

outcome.shipped: Designed: member overview, adjust points, wallet and stamps, redeem and undo offers, cancel adjustments, and the activity timeline with type filters, for each admin role.
outcome.measures: Measures that matter: time to resolve a member question, and how many manual adjustments are later cancelled.
outcome.learnings: Designing the undo path together with each action kept the page simple, because nothing had to be over-protected when it could be reversed.
